script.speaker: liam
script.text: everyone drop everything. the noodle stall, the one nobody could find all summer: the girl upstairs works the market and she swears it's on the noodle row

script.speaker: liam
script.text: which cart, she wouldn't say. just 'you'll know at the first slurp'

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: finally!! you've talked about this stall all summer. i am not missing the ending

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: i'm down. i'll check every cart myself if i have to

script.speaker: maya
script.text: i'm in, but my coin purse is the whole budget tonight. if a price board makes me break a bill, i will be very dramatic about it

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Count me in. I've already sketched the row: fourteen carts, two exits, one bench that actually gets a breeze.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: cyrus, while you're sketching, cross off any cart with peanut in it. wok oil, sprinkled on top, all of it. one satay incident was plenty

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: my grandma lands tomorrow and her first question is always "are you eating your greens?" i want to say yes and mean it

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: a bowl that's actually green and doesn't leave me feeling like a fried dumpling. my body is begging

script.speaker: maya
script.text: your grandma asks about greens. mine asks if i'm "still eating noodles standing up". we are not the same

script.speaker: liam
script.text: oh and roxy, remember the milkshake? my tipster says a lot of carts on that row finish the broth with butter or a splash of milk

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: how does your tipster know every broth on the row and not which cart is THE cart

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Assistant, the row is long and Liam's tip ends there. Over to you.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: one slurp. that's all i need
